evidence.head: Dispatch exceeds the next cause by 37 percentage points

pages.title: 55% adoption reaches the $1.8m annual-value gate
pages.scope: Adoption and annual value | Illustrative linear model | $m/year
pages.source: Source: Illustrative model; annual value ($m) = −1.5 + 0.06 × adoption (%)

panel.label: Annual value at 55% adoption
panel.text: Move adoption to find where the investment decision changes.

pages.takeaway: Below 55% adoption, the model no longer clears the investment gate.

evidence.head: 55% adoption is the investment decision boundary
assumptions: Displayed amounts are in millions of US dollars per year. Enter adoption as a percentage value, such as 55. The calculation retains exact integer units of $10,000 internally.
This is an illustrative linear relationship, not evidence of a causal effect from greater adoption.
The gate is at least $1.8m/year. Exactly $1.8m also passes.

assumptions: This fictional model adds fixed contributions. All components enabled give 72 points.
Only manager capacity and system integration can be toggled in this example.
Adding East requires readiness ≥70, adoption ≥55%, and confirmation of the staffing-constrained scenario.
